verdict.rationale: HumanLayer's release notes document a model selector that lets users pick specific models (GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, Claude Opus 5.5) across all agent backends, which covers choosing a model of your choice. The evidence is a single release-note line, and it never mentions an automatic model-selection mode to switch away from. Missing for 10: documentation of an automatic/default selection mode and of overriding it, in-depth docs on the model selector (scope per task/session/workspace, admin control), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can switch away from automatic model selection to a specific model of my choice

citations.quote: Pick GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, or Claude Opus 5.5 from the model selector across all agent backends.
